meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 制作短的设计感动画图形——比如动态文字、数字统计、图表动画、logo 动画、地图动画等，通常 10 秒以内、没有旁白，最终输出 MP4 或透明视频文件。它会先规划镜头、获取素材，再构建并渲染。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作短的设计感动画图形（如动态文字、数字统计、图表动画等）时触发；通常 10 秒内、无旁白，更长或有旁白会转给其他技能。

say.text: 把这份数据做成柱状图动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成图表动画视频。

say.text: 用这个 logo 做一个 sting 动画。
say.note: Claude 会制作 logo 动画并输出视频。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude create short design-led motion graphics — kinetic type, stat count-ups, charts, logo stingers, map animations, etc. Usually under 10s, no narration, output MP4 or transparent overlay. It plans, sources assets, builds, and renders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a short design-led motion graphic (e.g., kinetic type, stat count-up, chart animation). Typically under 10s without narration; longer/narrated pieces go to other skills.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second kinetic typography animation with the text 'Hello'.
say_en.note: Claude will render an MP4 short video.

say_en.text: Turn this data into a bar chart animation.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a chart animation video.

say_en.text: Make a logo sting with this logo.
say_en.note: Claude will create a logo animation and output video.
